invariants: child_protection = high_priority_gate != automatic_proof_of child presence or harm

repositories.role: civic-tech, data-governance, cultural-expression and research project
atoms: README explicitly rejects statehood, international personality, automatic certification and hash-based legal truth
best-interest, anti-exploitation, transparency and human review are declared governance controls; actual child-data presence remains deployment-specific
purpose limitation, minimization, legal basis, rights and incident response are declared; conformance requires implementation evidence
different material classes have distinct declared licensing and third-party preservation rules
independent legal review and real network validation remain explicitly open
repositories.next_gate: sample file-level license/provenance audit plus privacy-control implementation receipt and independent counsel review

repositories.role: AI-ethics, authorship-defense, mathematical/scripts and manifesto repository
atoms: README overextends copyright to ideas, algorithms and concepts; copyright authority protects original expression, not underlying ideas or methods as such
UNESCO AI Ethics Recommendation is human-rights and dignity centred standard-setting guidance, not private legal enforcement authority
standard MIT grant is followed by non-license symbolic text in the LICENSE file
similarity/origin assertions require reproducible methodology, controls and independent validation
repositories.next_gate: separate canonical license from manifesto and build claim-by-claim IP authority/evidence table

repositories.role: public spiritual, authorship and legal manifesto
atoms: README exposes direct personal identifiers and location-related biographical data; values are intentionally not replicated in this ledger
self-publication context matters, but public availability does not erase purpose, necessity, security, onward-use or third-party privacy questions
private spiritual declarations do not by themselves create universal public-law authority, state sovereignty, treaty effect or automatic international sanctions
authorship may protect qualifying expression, not all ideas, methods, algorithms or discoveries by declaration alone
protection of children is declared as a mission value; no child subject or child dataset is established by this README alone
repositories.next_gate: minimize unnecessary direct identifiers in public surface; establish canonical license and separate symbolic-spiritual claims from legal-effect claims

atoms: biophysics and related domains are legitimate research fields; this does not validate every specific mechanism listed
multiple biomedical and biophysical mechanisms require claim-specific primary evidence and falsifiers
therapy, neural or cardiac intervention claims activate health-safety review if translated into intervention, device or human-subject research
market and impact valuations are unsupported in the observed material
no actual patient, child, biometric or genetic dataset is established by the observed README
repositories.next_gate: decompose claims into established/reference/hypothesis and attach primary literature, falsifiers, measurement protocol and ethics/device gate

atoms: repository contains operational-sounding radioactive-waste treatment concepts; no physical execution is authorized or inferred
IAEA GSR Part 5 and SSR-5 provide safety requirements for predisposal management and disposal; domestic legal force depends on competent national regulation and authorization
claimed changes to radioactive-waste behaviour are not supported by evidence in the observed repository
any biological or environmental remediation concept involving radioactive waste requires competent radiological, environmental and biosafety assessment
spiritual or intention-based variables are preserved as symbolic semantics and not treated as radiological protection or nuclear-physics mechanisms
repositories.next_gate: keep simulation/documentation-only; add explicit high-risk safety boundary; require qualified nuclear-science and regulator pathway before any physical material handling

official_anchors: personal-data treatment, sensitive-data definitions, purpose, necessity, transparency, security and accountability
UNESCO Recommendation on Ethics of AI
human rights and human dignity are foundational AI-ethics values
copyright protects qualifying expression and not ideas, procedures, methods of operation or mathematical concepts
requirements for protection of human health and environment in predisposal management
safety objectives, criteria and requirements for radioactive-waste disposal

resolution_refinements.resolve_jurisdiction: distinguish author location, data-subject location, deployment, regulated activity and target audience; hosting alone is insufficient
resolution_refinements.resolve_authority_hierarchy: constitution/law/treaty or competent regulator > incorporated regulation > official safety standard/guidance within scope > contract/license > project policy > symbolic manifesto
resolution_refinements.semantic_contextualize: spiritual, poetic and symbolic statements remain expression unless tied to a concrete legal, biomedical or engineering claim
resolution_refinements.cross_cultural_semantic_diff: spiritual sovereignty and sacredness may be meaningful cultural or religious semantics without becoming equivalent legal categories across jurisdictions
resolution_refinements.detect_normative_conflict: flag private-universal-authority claims, copyright-overbreadth, public-PII exposure, license-file ambiguity and high-risk scientific claims without competent evidence
resolution_refinements.protected_subject_gate: P0 when actual child, patient, biometric/genetic subject or identifiable personal data is present; mission statements alone do not prove subject presence
resolution_refinements.evidence_and_conformance_gate: legal, scientific, forensic and nuclear claims require domain-specific competent evidence; README, hash, symbolic seal or local code does not close those gates
resolution_refinements.temporal_validity: bind every conclusion to repo/ref/path/blob plus current legal or safety source version
resolution_refinements.provenance_chain: repo/ref/path/blob -> claim -> domain -> authority -> applicability -> evidence/falsifier -> conflict -> status
